images.title: Place the digits 1, 3, 7
images.purpose: Shows the digit arranger at its start: three tiles and three empty slots, the 7 heading to the multiplier.
images.composition: A tray of three tiles at the top and a row of three empty slots below.
images.exact_structure: Top: a light grey #6B7280 tray holding three square tiles 1, 3 and 7; the 7 tile is filled reddish purple #CC79A7 with a white numeral, the 1 and 3 tiles are white with dark outline. Below: three empty dashed square slots, two side by side for the two digit number, then a × sign, then one slot for the multiplier, which has a teal #0072B2 outline. One curved teal arrow runs from the 7 tile to the multiplier slot. Nothing else is drawn. Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, which is large and centred; no scenery, no people, no other text.

images.context: Practice picture for the digit arranger tool; answer 31 × 7 = 217.
images.teaching_notes: After the 7, put 3 then 1 in the two digit slots, and compare with 71 × 3 = 213.

image_decisions.why: The tool's starting state with the first move shown tells the child how to begin each practice item.
